item.title: CU-26-0020 - 1032 Mann St
item.description:
Notice at 1032 Mann St
Location: 1032 Mann St Reference: CU-26-0020
--- Full Notice Text --- NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING PLANNING ADVISORY BOARD This is to inform you that the Planning Advisory Board of the City of Kissimmee will consider a Conditional Use for educational services located at 1032 Mann St. The Planning Advisory Board will hold a meeting on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. at the City Commission Chambers, 101 Church St., Kissimmee, FL 34741. The subject property is located at 1032 Mann St., Parcel ID: 21-25-29-1588-0001-001 Any interested party wanting to be heard on this issue may submit testimony to be read into the official record to CityClerkEmail@kissimmee.gov prior to the start of the meeting or may be heard by participating in person. Any questions regarding this public hearing may be directed to the Development Services Department at (407) 518-2140 or planning@kissimmee.gov . Reference # CU-26-0020 Advanced Ultrasound FL PLANNING ADVISORY BOARD KISSIMMEE, FLORIDA\ In accordance with Florida Statutes 286.26, any person needing assistance to participate in any of these proceedings should contact the Office of the City Clerk in writing at least 48 hours prior to the meeting at cityclerkemail@kissimmee.gov or by telephone at (407) 518-2308. In accordance with Florida Statute 286.0105: any person wishing to appeal any decision made by the City Commission with respect to any matter considered at such meeting or hearing will need a record of the proceedings, and for such purposes may need to ensure that a verbatim record of the proceeding is made, which record includes the testimony and evidence upon which the appeal is made. 178977 November 3, 2026
